extDescription.message: Stream Deck control of the speed and quality of the video playing in Chrome. Talks only to the VJster actions on this computer.

portNote.message: The port the VJster actions on your Stream Deck listen on, on this computer only. Change it only if you changed it there.

idNote.message: To let only this extension connect, paste the id into the VJster settings on your Stream Deck.

allSites.message: Control videos on every site, not only YouTube

allSitesNote.message: Speed only: quality needs YouTube's player. Chrome asks for permission to read and change every site.

statusBadPort.message: Use a whole number from 1024 to 65535; $DEFAULT$ is the default.

statusSaved.message: Saved. VJster now connects to port $PORT$.

statusNotAllowed.message: Not allowed: VJster stays on YouTube only.

statusAllSites.message: VJster now controls videos on every site. Reload open tabs to include them.

statusYouTubeOnly.message: VJster is back to YouTube only.

statusYouTubeOnlyKept.message: VJster is back to YouTube only; Chrome kept the all-sites permission, remove it on the extension's details page.
